subject: Invitation to Annual Company Dinner
body: Dear Team, We are excited to invite you to our annual company dinner on Friday, December 10th at 7:00 PM. The event will be held at the Grand Hotel Ballroom and will include a delicious three-course meal, live entertainment, and a speech from our CEO. Please RSVP by November 30th. We look forward to celebrating another successful year together! Best regards, [Company Name]
